storyCards.headline: If You Wanna Get To Heaven: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Ozark Mountain Daredevils's "If You Wanna Get To Heaven" reached #25 on the Billboard Hot 100. The Ozark Mountain Daredevils are an American rock band formed in 1972 in Springfield, Missouri.

They are most widely known for their singles "If You Wanna Get to Heaven" in 1974 and "Jackie Blue" in 1975.

Bassist Michael "Supe" Granda has written a book about the band, It Shined.

The song peaked at #25 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 16 weeks on the chart.
